Root Cause Analysis — 6 issues
Reviews → Negative Handling 2.0
Zero negative or mixed reviews are displayed. There is no evidence of brand responses to concerns, no discussion of adjustment periods, and no acknowledgment of cases where results took longer or required lifestyle changes.
Curate and display 2-3 mixed reviews (3-4 star) where customers mention slow initial results but eventual improvement. Add visible brand responses addressing: (1) typical 60-90 day timeline for visible results, (2) importance of consistency, (3) diet/lifestyle factors. Create a FAQ section directly addressing 'What if it doesn't work for me?' with refund/guarantee policy.
Persona × Narrative → Hero / Banner 3.5
The headline 'Biotin Hair Gummies (30N)' is purely product-descriptive and fails to address the configured narrative's core revelation that 'the real cause of hairfall is internal nutrition deficiency, not external remedies.'
Replace headline with: 'Your Comb Isn't Lying—But Your Remedies Are.' Subhead: 'Hairfall isn't about bad water or wrong shampoo. It's about what's missing inside.' Move '(30N)' to product details section. Ensure hero image shows the gummy product alongside a visual of the problem-solution contrast (external remedies crossed out vs. internal nutrition).
Persona × Narrative → Carousel Flow 3.0
Carousel slides are labeled generically (live_1 through live_11) with no visible content describing the narrative arc. Missing entirely: the myth-busting revelation moment that challenges 'paani kharab hai' or 'ghar ke nuske' beliefs.
Restructure 11 slides: Slides 1-2 (Hook): 'Hairfall everywhere? Tried everything?' + image of comb with hair. Slides 3-4 (Failed Remedies): 'Oils, shampoos, gharelu nuske—none fix what's inside' + crossed-out products. Slides 5-6 (Revelation): 'DHT + Nutrition gaps = real culprits your mirror won't tell you' + simple diagram. Slides 7-8 (Solution): Ingredient benefits with absorption visual. Slides 9-11 (Proof): '2.4M units sold' + before/after testimonial snapshots + 90-day timeline.
Persona × Narrative → Banner Alignment 3.5
Banners appear to show ingredient callouts (Biotin, procapil, Vitamins) which support the science-backed pillar but fail to reinforce the myth-busting narrative. The '2.4M units sold' proof point exists in body copy but isn't visually emphasized in banners.
Create 3 new banners: (1) Myth-buster: 'Tried every oil? Here's why they failed.' with comparison visual. (2) Social proof: '2.4M gummies consumed—India's most trusted hair nutrition' with trust badges. (3) Urgency: 'While you wait for oils to work, hairfall progresses. Internal fix starts Day 1.' Rotate these in primary banner positions above the fold.
Visual Design → Lifestyle Shots 3.5
Lifestyle imagery is almost entirely absent. No images showing the persona in his actual life - no college setting, hostel room, office desk, gym, social situations, or dating scenarios. The single human image (image 7) is a neutral studio shot.
Commission 3-4 lifestyle shots: (1) Young professional confidently running hands through hair before a meeting. (2) College-age guy in casual social setting—relaxed, not checking for fallen hair. (3) Dating scenario or getting-ready moment with confident body language. (4) Before/after emotional contrast—stressed checking pillow vs. relaxed morning routine. Place lifestyle shot in top 3 carousel positions.
Reviews → Freshness 3.0
All 4 reviews are from late February 2026, approximately 173-176 days old. There are no reviews from the last 5+ months, indicating a significant gap in recent customer feedback.
Immediate: Implement automated post-purchase email sequence at Day 7 (delivery confirmation), Day 30 (first results check-in), and Day 60 (full results window) requesting reviews with incentive (discount on next purchase). Add review prompts in packaging/inserts. If reviews truly dropped due to sales decline, investigate root cause. Target: minimum 4-6 fresh reviews monthly visible on PDP.

Human presence is limited - only appears in image 7 (How to use slide showing a man in his late 20s/early 30s holding a gummy) and images 2-4 showing top-of-head scalp shots without faces. The man in image 7 appears slightly older and more confident than the confused, panicking early-stage hairfall guy in college/first job. No emotional connection showing the persona's frustration, fear, or eventual empowerment. The scalp shots are clinical but don't show relatable scenarios like checking the mirror anxiously or running hands through hair.
Add a hero image showing a younger man (20-24) in a relatable setting - checking his comb with concern, noticing hair on pillow, or looking at shower drain. Include his face showing the emotional journey from worry to confidence. Show the same person in before/after scenarios to match the narrative arc.
Proof Prominence
4.0/10
Clinical proof is weak and buried. Image 5 says 'Clinically Proven Ingredients' but provides no percentages, no study results, no specific efficacy data. The nutritional content table (image 9) shows %RDA values but these are not translated into hair-specific outcomes. '10 Lakh+ Men trust Us' in image 8 is a social proof stat but lacks conversion metrics like '% saw reduced hairfall in 90 days'. No dermatologist endorsements or clinical trial results visible.
Add a prominent slide with specific efficacy claims: '78% saw reduced hairfall in 90 days' or 'Clinically tested with X% improvement in hair retention'. Make these stats large (40pt+ font), use contrasting colors (bright yellow or green callout boxes), and position them in the first 3 carousel images. Add dermatologist recommendation badges.
Ingredient Imagery
7.5/10
Ingredient visualization is well-executed in images 5, 17-19 with premium glass sphere/bubble aesthetic for Biotin (pink ribbon structure), Zinc (silver molecular clusters), and Vitamins A, C, E (golden oil droplets). The scientific/lab aesthetic with beakers in image 1 adds credibility. However, image 18 is labeled 'procapil' but shows Zinc imagery - there's an inconsistency. The DHT Blocker blend (grape seed, green tea) mentioned on packaging is not visualized anywhere.
Create a dedicated visual for DHT Blocker showing grape seed and green tea imagery with the same premium sphere aesthetic. Fix the procapil/zinc labeling inconsistency. Add brief benefit text beneath each ingredient sphere explaining the hair-specific benefit (e.g., 'Biotin: Reduces breakage by strengthening keratin structure').
Before / After
7.0/10
Before/after evidence is present in images 20-23 showing comb (with/without hair), hands (with/without fallen hair), shower drain (clogged vs clean), and pillow (hair-covered vs clean). These are highly relatable to the persona's pain points. Images 2-4 show scalp progression stages with dotted line indicators. However, no direct scalp before/after with the SAME person showing regrowth or density improvement. The transformation focuses on reduced shedding rather than visible hair improvement.
Add a before/after of the same scalp showing reduced thinning or improved density after 90 days. Include timeline markers (Day 1 vs Day 90). Make the before/after images larger and place them earlier in the carousel (within first 5 images) for immediate credibility impact.

Body Copy (12 blocks)
Enriched With Zinc, Biotin & Multivitamins For Hair
2.4M units sold
While our gummies are yummy, we recommend you stick to having no more than one gummy a day.
Hair thinning usually happens when hair follicles become miniaturised over time because of sensitivity to DHT - a by product of testosterone. Adequate Zinc consumption helps keep DHT in check, helping with this. The nutrients in them, like biotin, also help strengthen weak hair.
While these gummies might not directly help with hair growth, they do help nourish your scalp and strength your hair follicles.
In order to get positive results when supplementing with vitamins like Biotin, consistency is key. These delicious gummies are super easy to consume, helping you stay on track with your supplementation, every day. It's also fortified with additional helpful ingredients like Zinc and Vitamins A, C and E, for added benefits.
It would be best if you took it at the same time daily to make sure it's a habit and you're consistently taking one gummy a day. For example, as a dessert after your lunch daily.
Yes, naturally gluten-free.
These gummies are made from plant-based ingredients and plant-based ingredients do not have a uniform colour. The colour may range from greenish to brownish based on natural raw material variations. We do not use artificial colours to maintain the visual look of the gummies. The colour does not impact the product's efficacy, quality, shelf life, or taste.
Improving hair texture is a long process. We would recommend having these gummies for at least 3-4 months to see visible results.

Body Copy (9 blocks)
Hair thinning usually happens when hair follicles become miniaturised over time because of sensitivity to DHT - a by product of testosterone. Adequate Zinc consumption helps keep DHT in check, helping with this. The nutrients in them, like biotin, also help strengthen weak hair.
While these gummies might not directly help with hair growth, they do help nourish your scalp and strength your hair follicles.
In order to get positive results when supplementing with vitamins like Biotin, consistency is key. These delicious gummies are super easy to consume, helping you stay on track with your supplementation, every day. It's also fortified with additional helpful ingredients like Zinc and Vitamins A, C and E, for added benefits.
It would be best if you took it at the same time daily to make sure it's a habit and you're consistently taking one gummy a day. For example, as a dessert after your lunch daily.
We recommend you stick to having no more than one gummy a day.
Naturally gluten-free.
These gummies are made from plant-based ingredients and plant-based ingredients do not have a uniform colour. The colour may range from greenish to brownish based on natural raw material variations. We do not use artificial colours to maintain the visual look of the gummies.
Improving hair texture is a long process. We would recommend having these gummies for at least 3-4 months to see visible results.

Hair Vitamins with Zinc & Biotin for Hair
Hairfall noticed on comb, pillow, and hands after shower. Just use Man Matters Hair Gummies (30 N): Contains Biotin, Zinc, and Vitamins A, C & E which strengthen hair roots from within by nourishing follicles with essential nutrients.
Use it consistently for 90 days to see visible reduction in hairfall.
Just take 1 gummy a day after any meal.
93% men saw reduced hairfall in 90 days.
Complete your hair nutrition. Now.
1 Pack consists of 60 Biotin Hair Gummies
Eat 1 daily at the same time
Biotin is known to improve keratin structure
Zinc has hair strengthening properties
+ 23 more blocks
Vitamin A is known to boost hair health, adding moisture to the scalp
One of the reasons for hair thinning is free radical damage
Contains Permitted Natural Flavour(s).
One gummy per day
Note: There is no specific time for having these hair gummies. We recommend you treat it as your dessert after lunch or fix a particular time to have these biotin gummies.
These hair gummies are the first step towards having nourished hair. If you're looking to improve your hair health, you should explore shampoos, serums and other products targeted to give you a nourished mane.
Though these hair vitamins are meant to fill nutritional gaps it won't replace the need for nourished food. Ensure you have good dietary foods such as eggs, spinach and other green leafy vegetables to help boost your hair health.
Plastic combs cause micro-tears in your scalp, weakening your follicles. A wooden comb evenly distributes sebum more evenly throughout the mane, making your hair resilient against everyday challenges.
All good things take time, so does improving hair health. Don't expect an immediate improvement in your hair quality.
Each person is different, and the way our solution works on everyone is different.
Hair improvement is a gradual process. While these biotin hair gummies would help in curbing hair thinning, it won't completely bring it to a stop. You still have to follow good hair hygiene and have a proper diet.
Talking about personal health is hard. Often embarrassing. We get that. So we took 'matters' into our own hands; and created a place for all matters of man. Hair, skin, weight, sleep, performance and much more. We get you, and we get what matters to you.
With so many unreliable sources and searches, it's hard to decide whom to trust. Our solutions are trusted by experts, and are backed by science. We believe that wellness has a science behind it and we want to make it more accessible.
Wellness is an actively pursued goal of being in a state of good health. We believe that compliance and discipline matter if you want to move towards wellbeing, and we get that it's not easy. We are here to handhold you and help you on this journey.
While our gummies are yummy, we recommend you stick to having no more than one gummy a day.
Hair thinning usually happens when hair follicles become miniaturised over time because of sensitivity to DHT - a by product of testosterone. Adequate Zinc consumption helps keep DHT in check, helping with this. The nutrients in them, like biotin, also help strengthen weak hair.
While these gummies might not directly help with hair growth, they do help nourish your scalp and strength your hair follicles.
In order to get positive results when supplementing with vitamins like Biotin, consistency is key. These delicious gummies are super easy to consume, helping you stay on track with your supplementation, every day. It's also fortified with additional helpful ingredients like Zinc and Vitamins A, C and E, for added benefits.
It would be best if you took it at the same time daily to make sure it's a habit and you're consistently taking one gummy a day. For example, as a dessert after your lunch daily.
Yes, naturally gluten-free.
These gummies are made from plant-based ingredients and plant-based ingredients do not have a uniform colour. The colour may range from greenish to brownish based on raw material variations. We do not use artificial colours to maintain the visual look of the gummies. Please note that the colour does not impact the product's efficacy, quality, shelf life, or taste.
Improving hair texture is a long process. We would recommend having these gummies for at least 3-4 months to see visible results.
